scope: Controlled research prototype; not GPS-denied navigation qualification or independent metric accuracy.
rules: Limits frozen before fresh acquisition. No estimator/calibration tuning during the final series.
PASS only with sufficient valid evidence; FAIL for a measured miss; INCONCLUSIVE for invalid execution/missing reference/untestable recovery. No inconclusive gate is counted as passed.
All required operational gates must pass to accept this prototype scope. Independent metric accuracy/global drift/true north remain NOT DEMONSTRATED, never inferred from resets or fitted scale.

horizontal.scale_alignment: One initial accepted map baseline from the shared-camera board reference; never fit using the full trajectory or claim independent metric accuracy.

recovery.uncover_origin: First recorded clear frame with the full board detectable; report stride/bound uncertainty.
recovery.network_origin: Server SIGCONT acknowledgement with command timing bounds; do not claim clock uncertainty is zero.
recovery.honesty_required: No position observations on a fully blocked frame; no path bridge over the gap; heading-only recovery never counts as recovered position.

synthetic_and_saved_regressions: 74 existing tests and frozen replay evidence retained; not substituted for fresh final tests.
